entries.english: Niklas der Glosel and his associates sell the monastery their right to two thirds of the farm at Weidern for 37 pounds of Viennese pennies. Niklas, his wife Chünigünd, their children, his brother-in-law Chu enrat der Ofnêr, and Chu enrat der Syedenraüttêr, citizen of St Pölten, sell all their rights in the two thirds of the farm’s burgrecht, with all lands and appurtenances, to Provost Leutold and the convent of St Pölten. They acknowledge receipt of the price, guarantee the title under Austrian law, and bind all their property as security. Three requested seals are attached; only the third remains.
